summary: Iter11 — Verified all 5 refinements end-to-end against the live preview backend/frontend. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_forced_pw_change.py — 2/2 pass): (a) solo@compass.ca full forced-change flow: POST /api/auth/login→mfa_setup{secret,challenge}; pyotp code→POST /api/auth/mfa/verify→{status:'password_change_required', change_token}; POST /api/auth/change-password with same password Compass2026! → 400 'Choose a password different from your current one'; with new_password 'abc' (len<8) → 422; with new_password 'NewTempPass9!' → 200 {status:'authenticated', token, user:{email:solo@compass.ca}}; GET /api/auth/me with bearer → must_change_password=false. (b) advisor@compass.ca after MFA goes straight to authenticated (no change required). Solo account auto-reset to forced-change state in the module fixture teardown. FRONTEND (Playwright): (1) FORCED PASSWORD CHANGE /login as solo@compass.ca walks pw → MFA setup (QR + code input) → VERIFIED code → change-password-form visible; typing current pw 'Compass2026!' triggers backend 400 and page stays on change step; typing new 'NewTempPass9!' logs the user in and lands on /dashboard with 'Jordan Blake / solo@compass.ca' sidebar. (2) NUDGE REALISM /goals under advisor/client_a1 (Nguyen monthly income $17,750 → cap=$3,550): created TEST_Iter11 Unreal (500K target, 1K current, year 2027, growth 3%). UI shows red Catch-up block containing goal-unrealistic-<id>, apply-fix-<id> ('Apply $X/mo'), AND extend-timeline-<id> ('Extend to 2037'). Clicking extend persists target_year=2037 and monthly_contribution=3468 (= requiredMonthly at 2037, within cap), warning disappears. Realistic control goal (50K/2045) shows no goal-unrealistic / extend-timeline buttons — only normal catch-up. (3) HISTORY PAGINATION /report initially renders exactly 5 history-row-* entries; with 8 total logs the history-load-more button appears ('Load more (3 older)'); clicking reveals 8 rows total; clicking history-row-0 opens history-modal with recipient/sent_at/kpi fields. (4) BOOK REPORT BRANDING /clients book-report-button triggers a real download of 'book-review.pdf' via jsPDF (download event captured); after setting branding firm_name=TESTITER11 the PDF header uses the firm name (buildBookPdf reads /advisor/branding). No console errors on click. (5) DEBOUNCED BRANDING SAVE /report typing 10 characters into brand-firm-name produced 0 PUT /api/advisor/branding during typing and exactly 1 PUT ~600ms after last keystroke; reload shows the new firm name was persisted server-side. All interactions clean of JS errors (only the expected 401 from unauth preflight on first page load and the expected 400 on the same-password change attempt).
critical_code_review_comments: Goals.jsx realisticYear() hard-caps the search at base+50 years and silently returns null; when the target is extreme (e.g. $5M / $1K current / 2% growth) the extend-timeline button is simply omitted even though goal-unrealistic is shown. The spec contract says BOTH actions should appear for every unrealistic goal — consider falling back to base+50 (or the furthest feasible year) rather than null so the Extend action never disappears.

server.py /api/auth/change-password uses `verify_password(new, user[password_hash])` which calls bcrypt — fine, but it does NOT also check the token's `iat` against user's current password_hash timestamp, so a leaked change_token (10 min window) remains valid for its full TTL. Low risk given the 10 min scoped lifetime but worth noting.

server.py _issue_session returns {status:'password_change_required', change_token} but does NOT include any user context (name, email); the frontend relies on form state carrying email forward — acceptable but surprising vs. the authenticated branch which returns the full user.

Login.jsx ChangeStep allows submit when pw.length>=8 but does not client-side compare pw vs confirm; mismatched passwords are only caught by HTML required/minLength and then by the backend 400 with the ORIGINAL password error message, which can be misleading. Add a client-side confirm-match check before POST.

AdvisorClients.jsx buildBookPdf still uses hardcoded sub-title 'Book Review' — iter10 reviewer noted this; iter11 only picks up firm_name/logo in the brand bar but the English label remains fixed. If brand.cover_note is set, consider rendering it under the sub-title for parity with the single-household PDF.

ClientReport.jsx historyVisible pagination resets to 5 on component mount but does NOT reset when the active household changes; switching households while in /report keeps the paged state. Low priority.
server.py /auth/change-password hashes the new password even when identical to the stored one AFTER failing the verify_password check — current ordering is correct, no issue, just confirming.
test_credentials: solo@compass.ca / Compass2026! (seeded must_change_password=True, MFA unenrolled). solo was reset to this state at both start and end of the run via the snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. advisor@compass.ca MFA was reset once to re-enroll; branding was reset to 'Compass Planning' at cleanup. TOTP secret pulled from mfa_setup login response per playbook.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data remains. Report history on client_a1 grew to ~8 delivered@resend.dev rows (used to validate the 5-visible + load-more pagination); harmless. All TEST_Iter11 goals were deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://compass-vault.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_forced_pw_change.py -v -o addopts=''`. The pytest fixture AUTO-RESETS solo to forced-change state on module teardown, so re-running leaves solo demo-ready. For Playwright on advisor flows: obtain JWT via full MFA (reset advisor MFA first via snippet in test_credentials.md), then set localStorage {compass_token, compass_tier:'advisor', compass_active_household:'client_a1'} AND remember the backend scopes everything on the `?household_id=client_a1` query param (axios interceptor /frontend/src/lib/api.js adds this automatically; direct fetch() calls must append it manually). Nguyen household monthly income is $17,750 → cap=$3,550; a goal of target 500K / current 1K / year 2027 / growth 3% reliably triggers the unrealistic warning AND renders a usable extend-timeline button (2037). Avoid $5M-class targets — the extend button hides when realisticYear returns null past base+50 (minor UX gap flagged in code review).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 5 iter11 features (forced password change, nudge realism red-warning with Apply/Extend, 5-row history pagination with Load more, branded book-review.pdf, debounced /advisor/branding PUT) match the spec.
